title_ar: عربة أطفال يويو2 من بيبي زين
spec_blocks_raw: Weight: 6.2 kg. Suitable from 6 months up to 22 kg. Dimensions folded: 52 x 44 x 18 cm. Cabin luggage size. Premium frame.
description_raw: The YOYO2 stroller folds and unfolds in a moment, can be worn over the shoulder and tucks in anywhere. Catch the subway, get on a bus, jump in a taxi or fly to the other side of the world!
pros_raw: Can be taken as cabin luggage
cons_raw: Requires separate newborn pack for 0-6 months
review_snippets: Perfect for our trips, fits right in the overhead bin.
Folds beautifully but a bit pricey when you add everything up.

title_ar: عربة أطفال لايت واي من شيكو
spec_blocks_raw: Weight approx 7.5 kg. Multi-position recline. Suitable from birth to 15kg.
description_raw: Practical and lightweight stroller suitable for everyday walks.
cons_raw: Not very smooth on rough terrain
review_snippets: Great for the price but the umbrella fold makes it hard to fit in a small trunk.

description_raw: The city stroller that folds in one second. Designed for travel and city life.
